name: wthresh
expr: ys = wthresh(v, 's', 1); yh = wthresh(v, 'h', 1); yss = wthresh(vs, 's', 1); yts = wthresh(v, 's', single(1)); yc = wthresh(vc, 's', 1); ych = wthresh(vc, 'h', 1); yt = wthresh([1 5 2], 's', [1 2 1]);
comment: Sig y=wthresh(x,sorh,t): soft 's' shrinks toward 0 by t, hard 'h' zeroes |x|<=t. Argcheck portion 2026-09-19: X is double/single (complex computed - soft keeps the phase: z*(|z|-t)/|z|); T is real scalar or same-size elementwise; the result takes single from either X or T. Branches: dbl/sgl soft+hard, complex soft+hard, T-single contagion, elementwise T. Deferred: none (int/logical/char X reject - same rejection class as ref).
